description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mount Lavinia, Ratmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521004 (7676)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific changes to land parcel records, including amendments to ownership interests, parcel numbers, access rights, and land extents for various properties in different locations. The content is purely land and property-related, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it involves land title registrations, property ownership details, and cadastral map references without any government personnel changes or structural administrative matters.
